items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Dave John Alexander is made by the Interviewer, who states that Marshall Lawrence told him about Dave John Alexander. There is no evidence in the text that Ferrand Clementin personally knew, met, or collaborated with Dave John

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, it was hard to travel. You know how we could catch that train at Union Station, and he gets at... Get off at La Pass. At La Pass. Because that day when they didn't scheme about it, as long as they had to give them. Yeah. A little longer than that paper, not quite as wide as paper. Yeah. And when they didn't pay, come on when it was rough, when they would go down, you didn't see me. Yeah. And then when they split, you said, come on. Yes. And I used to write, come hear me, the same way that they escape.…

Oh, yeah. Well... You know Marshall Lawrence from Reserve? Used to have a band up there? He would tell me all about that. Uh-huh. But it's on this side. Yeah, he's on this side in Reserve, and he would tell me all about how Dave John Alexander used to write a trumpet play, and he got grounded up there.
